The p.9 locator identifies the benefit-rating camp-size main effect, F=160.5, with same-test printed p,.001 (p<.001). Requested d is not printed in the inspected results, so the printed F is retained without conversion. The p field is an unassigned placeholder; its same-test bound is preserved here and in the effect evidence. Recruitment n=162 and rounded exclusion percentage 17% do not establish the exact analytic N. No N inferred from df=132; no calculation from rounded percentages. There are no explicit mutually exclusive final-group counts to sum. The decision camp-size effect F(1,130)=105.4, p<.001 occurs on source page 10 and is a different outcome, not the p.9 benefit-rating target.
